title: Discover Hidden Nonprofit Gems
description: 40% of high-impact nonprofits have zero web presence. Small organizations doing critical work are invisible to donors.

slides.headline: The Visibility Gap
slides.subheadline: Great nonprofits exist. You just can't find them.

slides.label: Part 1: The Problem
slides.headline: 40% of Great Organizations Are Invisible
slides.accent_label: High-Impact Nonprofits with Zero Web Presence
slides.story: Food banks. Tutoring programs. Animal rescues. These organizations save lives every day. Yet 40% have zero online presence. Donors can't find them. Organizations can't find donors. The gap costs lives.

slides.label: Part 2: What Exists
slides.headline: 33,900 Hidden Gems Waiting to Be Found
slides.story: We indexed all 1.7M U.S. nonprofits. We found 33,900 with strong financial health, working quietly in communities across America. Most have never been discovered by a donor. They don't lack impact. They lack visibility.

slides.label: Part 3: The Solution
slides.headline: Search Changes Everything
slides.accent_label: Nonprofits Searchable by Cause, Location, Health
slides.story: Donors get data. Search by cause. Search by neighborhood. See financial health. Find the exact organization you want to support—not the famous one everyone knows about. Discovery meets impact.

slides.headline: Find Hidden Impact
body_lines: Support the organizations nobody else found.
